{"reason": "v1's 4 stockouts (195000 rows, e.g. inv 2.8/5.3) all came from late alternative suppliers, and at 45000 the switch is dominated by alert-planner (35000, always on time). One edit: replace the suggest-alternative branch with monitor and widen the alert branch to medium risk with inventory-days < 8 (max observed regular-lead), so high inventory monitors safely. Cost and stockouts both fall, meeting the gate.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 8))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
